text: Moving the peak later is position, not intensity, so the ceiling of 2 and permittedLandings still hold. One safety condition: in bedtime mode a peak in the last third shortens the wind-down between the most tense page and sleep. Bedtime arcs should keep the peak away from the final pages (at least two settled pages after it) and the analysis should be done per mode, not pooled. As a corpus-vs-catalog comparison it needs no child data.
